description: Source file containing helper functions and configuration logic for Vulkan capabilities in ANGLE project, including extension support, device limits, and EGL configuration generation.

methods.name: LimitToInt
methods.description: Converts a uint32_t value to int, clamped to the maximum int32_t value.

methods.name: RendererVk::ensureCapsInitialized
methods.description: Initializes Vulkan device capabilities and extension support for RendererVk.

methods.name: egl_vk::ComputeMaximumPBufferPixels
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of pixels for a PBuffer based on device limits.

methods.name: egl_vk::GenerateDefaultConfig
methods.description: Creates a basic EGL configuration for given color, depth/stencil formats, and sample count.

methods.name: egl_vk::GenerateConfigs
methods.description: Generates a set of EGL configurations based on supported formats and device limits.
